summary: Talarico calls Oct 7 the 'deadliest day for Jews since the Holocaust' and affirms Israel's right to self-defense while condemning Netanyahu's 'forced famine and collective punishment' in Gaza. He pledged not to take AIPAC money and in August 2026 reaffirmed support for conditioning rather than ending U.S. military aid. Vote for Peace rates him an Ally; Track AIPAC's undated guide reports he voted for Texas SB 326 (IHRA in schools) and SB 2972 (campus speech restrictions), unverified roll calls.
